title: Interval Added where a Vehicle's Registration Papers Are Current
content:
The interval a completed inspection grants is fixed only after a verification of the vehicle's registration dated within thirty calendar days of the handling date stands on its condition record.

How much interval the papers add to a Keyturn Vehicle Listing turns on how many images that registration verification carried.

1. A vehicle whose registration has been verified within 30 calendar days of the handling date on a record carrying 12 or more images of it has 1500 miles added.

2. A vehicle whose registration has been verified within 30 calendar days of the handling date on a record carrying fewer than 12 images has 750 miles added.

3. Any other vehicle has nothing added on this ground, an addition of 0 miles.

### Where each boundary falls

| Most recent registration verification | Images that verification carried | Added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| within 30 calendar days of the handling date | 12 or more | 1500 miles |
| within 30 calendar days of the handling date | fewer than 12 | 750 miles |
| older than 30 calendar days, or none at all | any | 0 miles |

A registration verified exactly 30 calendar days before the handling date is within the window; one verified 31 calendar days before it is not. A verification carrying exactly 12 images is on the first row; one carrying 11 is on the second.
